name: More Arathi Basin Marks of Honor
label: Quest
description: More Arathi Basin Marks of Honor: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Friend, the Defilers has a standing mission for you to reenter Arathi Basin, procure more marks of honor and bring them to me.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good. I will get these to our quartermasters immediately, and a commendation for your actions will be sent to my superiors.
Once again, thank you friend. Your contributions to our struggles are noticed by grunt and high warlord alike.
